fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Fires 3 shots in a spread, each dealing 8 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Ram Prow
fusions.desc: Rams the target for 40 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Trade Winds
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster, and your wind resistance rises by 10%.
